en.title: Milk at one
en.oneLiner: Short answer: switching to cow’s milk is optional, not a must. Breast milk can keep going. Formula is usually done by 12 months. If you want a milk drink, whole cow’s milk is the easy default. From one, food is the meal; milk is a drink.

labels.pathHint: Tap one to see your step-by-step plan. (Saved on this phone.)
labels.planHint: For any formula or bottle feeds you’re replacing. Nursing can stay as is.
labels.countHint: Tap for each cup of cow’s milk or formula she drinks. Saved on this phone, resets daily. Nursing isn’t counted, and that’s fine.

counter.msgLow: A light day. Fine if she eats yogurt or cheese, or nurses.
counter.msgHigh: OK, upper end. No more needed today; offer water.
counter.msgOver: ⚠️ Over 24 oz. Too much milk crowds out food and can lower iron. Switch to water, and offer food first next time.
counter.legend: 1 cup = 8 oz · sweet spot ≈ 16 oz · max 24 oz

bigThree.title: It’s optional. Breast milk counts.
bigThree.sub: No one has to switch to cow’s milk
lines: Breast milk can continue to 2 years or beyond, as long as you both want (AAP, WHO).
Infant formula usually isn’t needed after 12 months. Toddler or “stage 3” formula isn’t needed either (AAP, WHO).
Whole cow’s milk is just the easiest way to get calcium, protein and vitamin D. Yogurt and cheese work too.

bigThree.title: Why wait until 12 months
bigThree.sub: By then, food becomes the meal
lines: Before 1, cow’s milk is hard on the kidneys and gut, is low in iron, and can cause tiny blood loss in poop, which can lead to anemia.
By 1, she gets most nutrition from food. Milk becomes a drink with meals, not the meal.
Yogurt and cheese in her food are fine before 1.
Want a preview? After 11 months, a 1-oz sip of whole milk in a cup lets her try the taste (CHOP).

bigThree.title: About 2 cups a day, never over 3
lines: Aim for about 16 oz (2 cups) of whole milk a day. 24 oz is the ceiling.
Too much milk fills her up, so she eats less iron-rich food. That can mean iron-deficiency anemia, and often constipation.
Whole milk (not skim or 1%) until 2. Use 2% only if the pediatrician suggests it.
Off the bottle by 12–18 months: milk goes in a cup, with meals.

paths.label: Breastfeeding
paths.intro: Good news: nothing has to change on her birthday. Breast milk is still great food in year two.
steps: Keep nursing as much as you both want. Breast milk counts as her milk, so there’s no need to count ounces.
Make food the main event: 3 meals + 2 snacks, with iron-rich foods (meat, eggs, beans, tofu, iron-fortified cereal).
Offer water in an open or straw cup at meals.

Optional: add whole milk, yogurt or cheese for calcium, e.g. a small cup (4 oz) with a meal. If you pump and want to stop, swap one pumped bottle for whole milk in a cup every few days (mix 1:1 first if she’s unsure).
At the 12-month visit, ask about vitamin D (most toddlers who drink under ~32 oz of fortified milk need a supplement) and iron screening.
paths.tip: Nursing a lot and barely eating? Mention it at the checkup, and try nursing after meals instead of before.

paths.label: Formula
paths.intro: Formula’s job is done around 12 months. Switch to whole milk gradually over 2–4 weeks.
steps: Skip “toddler” or “stage 3” formula. Whole cow’s milk plus food does the job (AAP, WHO).
Start with one feed: mix prepared formula with whole milk 1:1. Never mix powder into cow’s milk.
Every 3–4 days, use more milk and less formula, one feed at a time, until it’s all whole milk.
Serve it in a cup with meals or snacks. Drop daytime bottles first, then the nap bottle, and bedtime last.
Target about 16 oz a day in total, max 24. She’ll drink less than she did formula. That’s normal; food fills the gap.
paths.tip: Happy with straight whole milk on day 1? Great, skip the mixing.

paths.label: Both
paths.intro: Keep the nursing you enjoy, and swap the formula bottles for whole milk.
steps: Keep nursing sessions as they are. Morning and bedtime nursing often last the longest; no rush.
Replace formula feeds one at a time with whole milk in a cup (mix 1:1 first if needed).
Count only cow’s milk toward the 16–24 oz. Breast milk is extra, not a problem.
Lots of nursing + lots of milk + little food? Trim the cow’s milk first.
At the 12-month visit, ask about vitamin D and iron screening.
paths.tip: Pumping? Pumped milk can go in a cup too, on its own or mixed with whole milk.

lines: Practice a cup at meals with water (or breast milk / formula).
After 11 months: an optional sip of whole milk to try the taste.
Buy plain, pasteurized whole milk with vitamin D. No flavored milks.
Swap one feed (e.g. lunch) for a 1:1 mix in a cup.
Watch her tummy, poop and skin.
Make that feed all milk; start mixing a second one.
Daytime bottles are done.
Swap the rest of the daytime feeds.
Nap bottle → cup, or skip it.
Bedtime last: milk before tooth-brushing, then a book and a cuddle instead of a bottle.
Settle at about 2 cups a day. Nursing can stay.

schedule.note: Faster or slower is fine. Sick or teething week? Pause, then pick up again.

quiz.q: Give whole milk (not skim or 1%) from 12 months to 2 years
quiz.why: Fat helps her fast-growing brain. Switch to 2% only if the pediatrician suggests it for weight or family history.

quiz.q: Buy toddler “stage 3” formula so she doesn’t miss nutrients
quiz.why: AAP and WHO: not needed. Whole milk plus varied food is enough; toddler formulas cost more and often have added sugar. (Chinese guidance differs; see “Where experts disagree”.)

quiz.q: Serve milk in a cup at meals
quiz.why: Cups protect teeth and leave room for food. Aim to be off bottles by 12–18 months.

quiz.q: Let her fall asleep with a bottle of milk
quiz.why: Milk sitting on teeth overnight causes cavities. Milk first, then brush teeth, then book and cuddle.

quiz.q: Mix formula powder into cow’s milk to ease the taste
quiz.why: That makes it too concentrated. Mix prepared formula (or breast milk) with milk 1:1 instead.

quiz.q: Let her drink as much milk as she wants
quiz.why: Over 24 oz a day can push out iron-rich food and lead to anemia. About 2 cups is plenty.

quiz.q: Keep breastfeeding after her first birthday
quiz.why: AAP and WHO support breastfeeding to 2 years or beyond, as long as you both want.

quiz.q: Use oat or almond milk as her main milk
quiz.why: Most plant milks are low in protein. Unsweetened, fortified soy milk is the only close match; check with the pediatrician first. Skip rice drinks (arsenic).

quiz.q: Warm the milk a little if she refuses it cold
quiz.why: Slightly warm milk feels more like breast milk or formula, so it’s easier to accept.

watch: Hives, swelling, vomiting or trouble breathing after milk: possible allergy. Trouble breathing → call 911; otherwise call the doctor right away.
Blood in her poop, or repeated vomiting with fewer wet diapers.
Ongoing diarrhea, bloating, constipation, or much more spit-up after starting milk.
Pale skin or lips, very tired, or chewing ice, dirt or paper (possible low iron).
Drinking more than 24 oz a day and eating little food.
Refusing all milk and dairy foods for weeks (ask about calcium and vitamin D).
Not gaining weight, or you’re worried about how much she eats.

disagree.title: How much: 16 or 24 oz?
lines: AAP drinks chart: 16 oz (2 cups) a day at 12–24 months.
2019 US expert consensus: 16–24 oz, depending on how much food she eats.
Children’s Health (Dallas) dietitian: 12–16 oz.
China’s childcare feeding guideline: about 500 ml of milk a day.
Everyone agrees: no more than 24 oz.

disagree.title: Toddler formula: US vs China
lines: AAP and WHO: not recommended.
China’s National Health Commission guideline: at 1–2 years, if there’s no breast milk or not enough, a suitable toddler formula is still suggested, plus some fresh milk, yogurt and cheese.
Chinese Nutrition Society: for ages 2–3, prefers growth milk fortified with vitamin D and calcium.
Either way: about 500 ml of dairy a day, plain, and not sweet “milk drinks”.

disagree.title: Whole or 2%?
lines: US: whole for most kids until 2; 2% for some, if the doctor suggests it.
The 2026 US Dietary Guidelines lean toward full-fat dairy.
WHO: not enough evidence to choose, so no recommendation.
AAP’s own sample menu says “whole or 2%”.

disagree.title: Bottle deadline
lines: CHOP: as soon after 1 as possible.
AAP: sometime between 12 and 18 months.

disagree.title: Vitamin D dose
lines: US: from age 1, kids need 600 IU a day; give a 400 IU supplement if she drinks under 32 oz of fortified milk.
China: 400 IU (10 μg) a day from birth to 18.

disagree.title: Cow’s milk before 1?
lines: WHO: for babies who aren’t breastfed, animal milk is acceptable from 6 months (low-certainty evidence; full-fat).
US: wait until 12 months.

details.title: Which milk to buy
lines: Whole, pasteurized cow’s milk, vitamin D fortified, plain.
Never raw (unpasteurized) milk.
Can’t do dairy? Unsweetened, fortified soy milk is the closest match; ask the pediatrician. Oat, almond and coconut milks are low in protein. Skip rice drinks.
Skip flavored milks, toddler “milk drinks” and juice.
Lactose-free whole milk is fine if lactose bothers her (true lactose intolerance is uncommon before 3).

details.title: A sample day
details.sub: Adapted from AAP’s menu for a ~21 lb one-year-old
lines: Breakfast: ½ cup iron-fortified cereal or 1 egg, ½ banana, a few strawberries + ½ cup milk
Snack: toast with peanut butter, or yogurt with fruit + water or ½ cup milk
Lunch: ½ sandwich, ½ cup green veggies + ½ cup milk
Snack: cheese cubes or fruit + water or ½ cup milk
Dinner: 2–3 oz meat, ½ cup orange veggies, ½ cup pasta or potato + ½ cup milk
That adds up to about 12–20 oz of milk. Breastfeeding? Swap the milk cups for nursing, water and yogurt or cheese.

details.title: Allergy or intolerance?
lines: Allergy is the immune system: hives, vomiting, blood in poop, trouble breathing. It usually shows up before 1 if she’s had formula or dairy.
Lactose intolerance is digestion: gas, bloating, loose poop. It isn’t dangerous, is uncommon before age 3, and can happen briefly after a stomach bug.
Already eats yogurt and cheese happily? A true milk allergy is unlikely.
Either way: stop, and call the pediatrician.

zh.title: 一岁转牛奶
zh.sub: Xyla 快满一岁 · 12 个月以后
zh.oneLiner: 先说结论：换牛奶不是必须的。母乳可以接着喂；配方奶一般到 12 个月就能停；想喝奶的话，全脂牛奶最省事。一岁以后，吃饭才是正餐，奶只是饮品。

labels.pathHint: 点一下，看对应的步骤（会记在这台手机上）。
labels.planHint: 针对要换掉的配方奶或奶瓶。亲喂照常就好。
labels.countHint: 她每喝一杯牛奶或配方奶就点一下。存在这台手机里，每天自动清零。母乳不用算。
labels.watchT: 🚩 出现这些情况，联系儿科医生
labels.disagreeT: ⚖️ 专家意见不一样的地方
labels.disagreeHint: 大方向一致，细节有出入。

counter.msgLow: 喝得不多，有吃酸奶、奶酪或者亲喂就没问题。
counter.msgHigh: 够了，已经偏多。今天别再加，渴了喝水。
counter.msgOver: ⚠️ 超过 720ml 了。奶喝太多会挤掉饭量，还会影响铁的吸收。接下来喝水，下次先吃饭再喝奶。

bigThree.title: 不是非换不可，母乳也算奶
bigThree.sub: 没人规定一岁必须喝牛奶
lines: 母乳可以喂到两岁甚至更久，只要你们俩都愿意。美国儿科学会（AAP）和世卫组织都支持。
一岁以后普通配方奶基本不用再喝；专门的幼儿配方奶（3段奶粉）美国儿科学会和世卫组织也都觉得没必要。
喝全脂牛奶只是补钙、补蛋白、补维D最方便的办法，酸奶、奶酪一样管用。

bigThree.title: 为什么要等到一岁
lines: 一岁前喝牛奶，肾和肠胃都吃不消；牛奶含铁少，还可能让肠道悄悄渗血，时间长了容易贫血。
满一岁，大部分营养靠吃饭，奶就成了配餐的饮品，不再是一顿饭。
辅食里加点酸奶、奶酪，一岁前就可以。
想提前试试口味？11 个月以后，每天用杯子让她抿一小口（30ml 左右）全脂奶就行（费城儿童医院的建议）。

bigThree.title: 一天两杯左右，别超过三杯
lines: 每天 480ml 左右（2 杯）全脂奶就够，720ml 是上限。
奶喝多了肚子就饱了，饭吃得少，铁跟不上，容易缺铁性贫血，也容易便秘。
两岁前喝全脂，别喝脱脂或 1%。要不要换 2%，听儿科医生的。
12～18 个月慢慢戒掉奶瓶，奶用杯子装，配着饭喝。

paths.label: 母乳
paths.intro: 好消息：过完生日什么都不用急着改，第二年的母乳照样是好东西。
steps: 想喂就接着喂，喂多久你们俩说了算。母乳就算她的奶，不用算喝了多少毫升。
把吃饭当正事：一天三顿加两次加餐，多安排含铁的食物，比如肉、蛋、豆子、豆腐、强化铁米粉。
吃饭时配一杯水，敞口杯、吸管杯都行。
想多补点钙，可以加全脂牛奶、酸奶或奶酪，比如吃饭时来小半杯（120ml）奶。在背奶想停的话，每隔几天把一瓶母乳换成一杯全脂奶；她不太接受，就先一比一混着喝。
一岁体检问问医生：要不要补维D（每天喝不到 950ml 强化奶的宝宝基本都要补），要不要查铁。
paths.tip: 总是吃奶、不怎么吃饭？体检时跟医生提一下，可以先把吃奶挪到饭后。

paths.label: 配方奶
paths.intro: 配方奶到一岁差不多就完成任务了，花 2～4 周慢慢换成全脂牛奶。
steps: 不用买幼儿配方奶或 3段奶粉，全脂牛奶加上好好吃饭就够了（美国儿科学会、世卫组织的意见）。
先换一顿：冲好的配方奶和全脂牛奶一比一混着喝。千万别直接用牛奶冲奶粉。
每隔 3～4 天，牛奶多一点、配方奶少一点，一顿一顿换，直到全换成牛奶。
用杯子装，配正餐或加餐喝。先停白天的奶瓶，再停午睡那瓶，睡前那瓶最后停。
一天总共 480ml 左右，最多 720ml。比以前喝配方奶的量少很正常，饭会补上。
paths.tip: 第一天就爱喝纯牛奶？那就不用混，直接换。

paths.label: 混合喂养
paths.intro: 喜欢的亲喂照常，配方奶那几顿换成全脂牛奶。
steps: 亲喂照常。早上和睡前那两顿往往留得最久，不用急着断。
配方奶一顿一顿换成杯子装的全脂奶，不接受就先一比一混着喝。
480～720ml 只算牛奶，母乳另算，多喂了也不用担心超量。
母乳多、牛奶多、饭吃得少？先减牛奶。
一岁体检问问维D和查铁的事。
paths.tip: 在背奶的话，挤出来的母乳也可以装杯子喝，单喝或者跟牛奶混着都行。

lines: 吃饭时用杯子练喝水（装母乳或配方奶也行）。
满 11 个月以后，可以让她抿一小口全脂奶尝尝味道。
买巴氏杀菌的全脂纯牛奶，最好强化了维D；调味奶、乳饮料别买。
把一顿奶（比如午饭那顿）换成一比一的混合奶，用杯子装。
留意肚子、便便、皮肤有没有异常。
这一顿换成纯牛奶，再开始换第二顿（先混着）。
白天不用奶瓶了。
白天剩下的几顿都换掉。
午睡那瓶改用杯子，或者干脆不喝。
最后换睡前：奶挪到刷牙前喝，刷完牙改成讲绘本、抱抱。
稳定在一天 2 杯左右。亲喂可以照常。

schedule.note: 快一点慢一点都行。生病或出牙那几天先停一停，好了再接着来。

quiz.q: 一岁到两岁喝全脂奶，不喝脱脂或 1%
quiz.why: 大脑正在飞速发育，脂肪很重要。只有医生因为体重或家族史建议时，才换 2%。

quiz.q: 怕营养不够，买幼儿配方奶（3段）
quiz.why: 美国儿科学会和世卫组织都说没必要：全脂牛奶加上吃得丰富就够了。幼儿奶粉更贵，还常常加糖。（国内指南说法不太一样，见下面“专家意见不一样的地方”。）
杯子对牙好，也不耽误吃饭。争取 12～18 个月戒掉奶瓶。
奶整夜泡着牙，最容易蛀牙。先喝奶，再刷牙，然后讲绘本、抱抱。

quiz.q: 用牛奶冲奶粉，让她慢慢适应味道
quiz.why: 这样冲出来太浓了。正确做法是冲好的配方奶（或母乳）和牛奶一比一混。
一天超过 720ml，会把含铁的饭菜挤掉，容易贫血。两杯左右就够。
美国儿科学会和世卫组织都支持喂到两岁甚至更久，只要你们俩都愿意。

quiz.q: 拿燕麦奶、杏仁奶当她的主要奶
quiz.why: 大部分植物奶蛋白质太少。只有无糖、强化过的豆奶比较接近牛奶，换之前先问医生。米浆别喝（砷超标的风险）。

quiz.q: 她嫌牛奶凉不肯喝，稍微温一下
quiz.why: 温一点喝起来更像母乳或配方奶，她更容易接受。

watch: 喝奶后起风团、脸肿、呕吐，或者呼吸困难，可能是过敏。喘不上气马上打 911，其他情况立刻打给医生。
便便里有血，或者反复呕吐、尿布明显变干。
开始喝牛奶后一直拉肚子、胀气、便秘，或者吐奶明显变多。
脸色、嘴唇发白，特别容易累，或者爱啃冰块、泥土、纸（可能缺铁）。
一天喝超过 720ml，饭却吃得很少。
好几周不碰牛奶，酸奶、奶酪也不吃（问问钙和维D怎么补）。
体重不长，或者你担心她吃得不够。

disagree.title: 喝多少：480 还是 720ml？
lines: 美国儿科学会饮品表：12～24 个月每天 480ml（2 杯）。
2019 年美国几家权威机构的共识：480～720ml，看饭吃得多少。
达拉斯儿童医院的营养师：360～480ml。
国家卫健委托育喂养指南：奶量每天约 500ml。
大家都同意：别超过 720ml。

disagree.title: 幼儿配方奶：中美说法不同
lines: 美国儿科学会、世卫组织：不推荐。
国家卫健委的指南：1～2 岁不能母乳或母乳不够时，仍建议喝合适的幼儿配方奶，再加点鲜奶、酸奶、奶酪。
中国营养学会：2～3 岁优选强化了维D和钙的成长奶。
不管选哪种：一天 500ml 左右，选纯奶，别拿乳饮料代替。

disagree.title: 全脂还是 2%？
lines: 美国：大多数孩子两岁前喝全脂，个别情况医生会建议 2%。
2026 年新版美国膳食指南更推全脂乳制品。
世卫组织：证据不够，没给建议。
美国儿科学会自己的一日食谱写的是“全脂或 2%”。

disagree.title: 奶瓶什么时候戒
lines: 费城儿童医院：过了一岁越早越好。
美国儿科学会：12～18 个月之间完成就行。

disagree.title: 维D补多少
lines: 美国：一岁以后每天需要 600IU；每天喝不到 950ml 强化奶的，补 400IU。
中国：0～18 岁每天 400IU（10 微克）。

disagree.title: 一岁前能不能喝牛奶
lines: 世卫组织：不吃母乳的宝宝，6 个月以后可以喝动物奶（证据等级低），要喝全脂的。
美国：一定等到 12 个月。

details.title: 买什么奶
lines: 巴氏杀菌的全脂纯牛奶，强化维D的更好，不要调味的。
没杀菌的生奶千万别喝。
不能喝牛奶？无糖强化豆奶最接近，先问医生。燕麦奶、杏仁奶、椰奶蛋白质太少，米浆别喝。
调味奶、乳饮料、果汁都别买。
乳糖不耐的话，可以喝无乳糖全脂奶（不过三岁前真正乳糖不耐的很少）。

details.title: 一天怎么吃（参考）
details.sub: 参考美国儿科学会给 9.5kg 左右一岁宝宝的食谱
lines: 早饭：半碗强化铁米粉或 1 个鸡蛋，半根香蕉，几颗草莓 + 半杯奶
加餐：吐司抹花生酱，或者酸奶配水果 + 水或半杯奶
午饭：半个三明治，半碗绿叶菜 + 半杯奶
加餐：奶酪块或水果 + 水或半杯奶
晚饭：60～90g 肉，半碗胡萝卜或南瓜，半碗面或土豆 + 半杯奶
这样一天奶大概 360～600ml。亲喂的话，把这几杯奶换成吃母乳、喝水、吃酸奶奶酪就行。（半杯 = 120ml）

details.title: 过敏还是乳糖不耐？
lines: 过敏是免疫系统的反应：起风团、呕吐、便便带血、呼吸困难。喝过配方奶或吃过奶制品的宝宝，一岁前一般就能发现。
乳糖不耐是消化的问题：胀气、肚子胀、拉稀，不危险。三岁前少见，拉肚子之后可能短暂出现。
平时吃酸奶、奶酪都没事？那真正牛奶过敏的可能性不大。
不管是哪种，先停下来，问儿科医生。
